name_reason: Well-formed per fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: this battle/animation routine executes one combat hit's worth of FIGANI cinematic frames (per-frame attacker/defender composite, progressive damage application, SFX hooks, crit/poison palette flash). No Ghidra address residue in the name; 'combat_hit_cinematic' accurately captures both the per-hit damage semantics and the cinematic per-frame rendering. No domain ID involved.
purpose: Executes the per-frame combat-hit cinematic for one strike phase: composites the attacker's strike against the shaken defender pose, applies HP damage progressively, fires per-frame SFX, and plays the crit/poison DAC palette flash; returns the defender's final HP.
logic_summary: Copies the 6-entry x/y shake offset tables to locals; counts hit-marker frames (frame[+4]!=0) in the attacker FIGANI into total_hit_frames (min 1); a 3% RNG roll (fd2_advance_rng_state()%100<3) or the double-hit flag raises hit_count to 2. Outer do-loop per strike: in non-scripted mode snapshots defender HP and calls fd2_calculate_combat_hit_outcome (6-dword block: miss/crit/poison/reserved/double-hit/damage); scripted mode forces the block to zero. Optional charge-in sub-animation (attacker_figani[+1]!=0) plays approach frames then a bg zoom transition, branching on attacker.team (team!=0 -> transition_in top-half workspace+0x140; team==0 -> transition_out bottom-half). Per-frame inner loop restores from framebuffer, composites attacker frame + defender pose (defender shaken by shake tables via a counter that resets to 5 on a landed hit and decays), frame[+7]&1 selects draw order; frame[+4]==1 marks a hit -> HP = HP_initial - hit_idx*damage/total_hit_frames (clamped >=0) and fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite (non-scripted); frame[+5] is an SFX hook (forced id 0 on a miss). On the final hit frame, poison flashes DAC 0x3C8/0x3C9 magenta and crit flashes white. Loop tail: defender HP==0 forces hit_count=0; while positive and attacker_figani[+1]==1 the attacker recoil + opposite-direction zoom replays for the second strike. Returns defender HP_current; scripted mode returns 1 early once the latched flag is 1 and the last hit landed.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_execute_combat_hit_cinematic(uint32 attacker_idx, uint32 defender_idx, uint32 attacker_figani, uint32 defender_figani, uint32 workspace, uint32 framebuffer, uint32 name_banner_sprite, uint32 sfx_bank)

params.name: attacker_idx
params.semantics: runtime_char index of the striking unit; selects team (top/bottom-half composite) and is passed to fd2_calculate_combat_hit_outcome.
params.reason: Accurate; matches usage rt_chars[attacker_idx].team and the outcome call. No address residue.

params.name: defender_idx
params.semantics: runtime_char index of the target; its hp_current is read and progressively written.

params.name: attacker_figani
params.semantics: Pointer to the attacker's FIGANI animation byte stream (frame count at +0, charge flag at +1, charge-frame count at +2, per-frame table at +8); drives the per-frame loop and hit-marker count.
params.reason: Accurate; this is the primary loop driver. No address residue.

params.name: defender_figani
params.semantics: Pointer to the defending side's FIGANI/silhouette pose stream composited (shaken) as the reacting target; caller passes the defender silhouette for the attacker phase and the attacker silhouette for the swapped counter phase.
params.reason: Accurate for this call's defender role; matches fd2_blit_indexed_sprite(defender_figani,...). No address residue.

params.name: workspace
params.semantics: 128 KB composite work buffer; sub-regions +0x140 (top-half) and +0x3EA8 (per-frame composite) are used as blit targets.
params.reason: Accurate; matches memset(workspace,0,0x1F400) and the offset composites.

params.name: framebuffer
params.semantics: 64 KB mode-13h scratch used as the restore source for each frame's fd2_blit_rectangle and the flash-hit target.
params.reason: Accurate; matches the restore-from-framebuffer blits and fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite(framebuffer,...).

params.name: name_banner_sprite
params.semantics: TAI.DAT name-banner RLE sprite passed through to fd2_animate_bg_zoom_transition_out for the bottom-half (enemy-attacker) zoom.
params.reason: Accurate; only consumed by the transition_out call. No address residue.

params.name: sfx_bank
params.semantics: FIGANI-extracted SFX handle bank for fd2_play_sfx_with_handle on per-frame SFX hooks.

returns.semantics: Defender's final hp_current after all hits applied (caller uses != 0 as 'defender survived this strike' to gate the counter-attack). In scripted mode, once the latched flag is 1 and the last hit landed, returns 1 early.

notes: src comment block (anicine.c lines 681-730) is already accurate, concise, ASCII, and correctly documents the Ghidra EAX-tracking artifact (the 3% bonus-hit roll keys off fd2_advance_rng_state()'s return value, which the decompiler mis-attributes to defender_idx*0x50; verified at disasm 0x2946a CALL then 0x2946f MOV EDX,EAX then IDIV 0x64 CMP EDX,3).
